source: PaperAid Final Implementation Rulebook v1.0 (28 September 2026), §11 and Appendix C1
note: The research concept note is PaperAid's academic concept paper (Research Proposals); CN-031 to CN-035 are applied there.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.purpose: The whole concept in miniature: problem, action, beneficiaries and expected result.

sections.heading: Problem and Evidence of Need
sections.purpose: Magnitude, population, geography and consequences, with evidence.

sections.heading: Target Group and Geography
sections.purpose: Direct and indirect beneficiaries, and where.

sections.heading: Relevance and Fit to Funder Priorities
sections.purpose: Why this call and this funder: the problem and approach tied to their priorities.

sections.heading: Approach: Goal, Objectives, Activities and Expected Results
sections.purpose: The core concept: goal, two to four objectives, main activities, outputs and outcomes.

sections.heading: Why This Applicant
sections.purpose: Specific delivery capability: projects, years, results, scale and partners' roles.

sections.heading: Timeline and Indicative Budget
sections.purpose: A high-level timeline and the indicative budget envelope.

sections.heading: Sustainability and Principal Risk
sections.purpose: How benefits continue, and the main implementation risk with its mitigation.

sections.heading: Summary
sections.purpose: The problem or opportunity, the proposed action, and the decision requested.

sections.heading: Context, Problem or Opportunity
sections.purpose: What the situation is, who it affects, and why it matters now.

sections.heading: Goal and Objectives
sections.purpose: The goal and two to four objectives.

sections.heading: Proposed Approach and Activities
sections.purpose: What will be done, in what sequence.

sections.heading: Intended Results
sections.purpose: Outputs and the change they should bring.

sections.heading: Target Group and Stakeholders
sections.purpose: Who benefits and who is involved.

sections.heading: Feasibility, Risks and Resources
sections.purpose: Resources needed, main risks and how they are handled.

sections.heading: Decision Requested and Next Step
sections.purpose: The decision or next step the reader is asked for.

questions.label: What problem or opportunity will the work address, for whom and where?
questions.help: Your own description is enough; PaperAid finds the evidence.

questions.label: What do you propose to do about it?
Who is the target group?
questions.fallback: PaperAid describes the target group from your description and marks it for you to confirm.

questions.label: Where will the work take place?
questions.fallback: PaperAid uses the place in your description, or keeps the geography general.

questions.label: How many months will the work last?
questions.fallback: PaperAid plans for 12 months and says so.

questions.label: Which currency is the budget in?
questions.fallback: The call's currency, otherwise US dollars.

questions.label: Your organisation: what it is, and the specific projects, years, results or scale that show it can deliver this work
questions.fallback: Without these facts the capacity section stays general and is marked for you to complete.

questions.label: Partners, if any, and what each will do
Which funder or call is this for?
questions.fallback: PaperAid writes for a general funder.

questions.label: Will the work involve children or vulnerable adults?
Will the work collect personal, health or identifiable data?
What is the indicative budget envelope?
questions.fallback: No figures are given; the budget part describes the main cost drivers only.

questions.label: What problem, opportunity or decision is this about?
What decision or next step do you want from the reader?
questions.fallback: PaperAid asks for approval to develop the full proposal.

questions.label: Who benefits, and who is involved?
questions.fallback: Described from your description and marked for you to confirm.

questions.label: How many months will the work last?
What resources will it need (people, money, time)?
questions.fallback: Resources are described in general terms and marked for you.

rules.requirement: Concept-note variant must resolve to research, project, funding, or external template.
rules.ui_message: The kind of concept note is settled

rules.requirement: If no external length exists, Standard targets 1,800 words for funding/research concepts and 1,500 for project concepts.
rules.ui_message: If no external length exists, Standard targets 1,800 words for funding/research concepts and 1,500 for project concepts.

rules.requirement: External page/word/character limits override PaperAid modes.
rules.ui_message: The call's own limits replace PaperAid's lengths

rules.requirement: The concept note should remain concise and decision-oriented rather than become a compressed full proposal.
rules.ui_message: It stays a concise, decision-oriented concept note

rules.requirement: A funding concept must identify a problem/opportunity and proposed intervention.
rules.ui_message: It identifies the problem and the proposed intervention

rules.requirement: The problem should identify who is affected, where, and why the issue matters.
rules.ui_message: The problem says who is affected, where, and why it matters

rules.requirement: Material factual claims in the problem section should be evidence-supported.
rules.ui_message: Material factual claims in the problem section should be evidence-supported.

rules.requirement: Objectives must respond directly to the stated problem.
rules.ui_message: The objectives answer the problem

rules.requirement: Funding concepts normally use 2–4 specific objectives unless external rules specify otherwise.
rules.ui_message: Two to four specific objectives

rules.requirement: Activities must plausibly contribute to objectives.
rules.ui_message: The activities plausibly lead to the objectives

rules.requirement: Outputs must be plausible products/services of proposed activities.
rules.ui_message: Outputs are things the activities produce

rules.requirement: Outcomes must describe plausible change rather than repeat activities.
rules.ui_message: Outcomes describe change, not activities

rules.requirement: Primary target group and geography should be identifiable when relevant.
rules.ui_message: The target group and geography are clear

rules.requirement: If a funding call exists, the concept must address its mandatory priority areas.
rules.ui_message: The call's priority areas are addressed

rules.requirement: A funding concept must explain why the applicant/consortium is credible for the work.
rules.ui_message: It shows why this applicant can deliver the work

rules.requirement: Capacity claims should use specific projects, years, results, roles, or scale rather than adjectives alone.
rules.ui_message: Capacity is shown with specific projects, years, results or scale

rules.requirement: Include an indicative budget when required or materially necessary to judge feasibility.
rules.ui_message: An indicative budget is included

rules.requirement: Include a high-level timeline when required or material.
rules.ui_message: A high-level timeline is included

rules.requirement: Indicative budget must be plausible relative to activities and duration.
rules.ui_message: The budget is plausible for the activities and duration

rules.requirement: Identify at least one principal implementation risk when risk is material.
rules.ui_message: The main implementation risk is named

rules.requirement: Address sustainability/continuation beyond initial support where relevant.
rules.ui_message: Continuation beyond the funding is addressed

rules.requirement: Funding concept may not exceed a stated funding ceiling.
rules.ui_message: The budget is within the funding ceiling

rules.requirement: Concept note may not exceed a hard external narrative limit after rendering.
rules.ui_message: Concept note may not exceed a hard external narrative limit after rendering.

rules.requirement: Mandatory external headings must appear in required order.
rules.ui_message: The required headings appear in the required order

rules.requirement: Funding-concept relevance must connect the problem and intervention to the funder priorities.
rules.ui_message: The problem and intervention are tied to the funder's priorities

rules.requirement: High-weight scoring criteria should receive proportionate depth.
rules.ui_message: High-weight scoring criteria should receive proportionate depth.

rules.requirement: PaperAid-added references must pass bibliographic verification.
rules.ui_message: PaperAid-added references must pass bibliographic verification.

rules.requirement: Evidence should be current enough for the claim unless older work is foundational/historical.
rules.ui_message: Evidence should be current enough for the claim unless older work is foundational/historical.

rules.requirement: Summary must accurately reflect problem, action, beneficiaries, and expected result.
rules.ui_message: The summary reflects the problem, action, beneficiaries and result

rules.requirement: Summary must not introduce commitments absent from the body.
rules.ui_message: The summary makes no commitment the body does not

rules.requirement: Research concepts must identify a research problem or gap.
rules.ui_message: Research concepts must identify a research problem or gap.

rules.requirement: Research objectives/questions must align with proposed methods.
rules.ui_message: Research objectives/questions must align with proposed methods.

rules.requirement: Research concept methods should cover design, setting/population, sampling/data source, data collection, and analysis at concept-note depth.
rules.ui_message: Research concept methods should cover design, setting/population, sampling/data source, data collection, and analysis at concept-note depth.

rules.requirement: Research concept should address ethics when human participants, personal data, vulnerable groups, or sensitive issues are involved.
rules.ui_message: Research concept should address ethics when human participants, personal data, vulnerable groups, or sensitive issues are involved.

rules.requirement: Research concept should state intended contribution/significance.
rules.ui_message: Research concept should state intended contribution/significance.

rules.requirement: Internal project concepts should state the decision/next step requested.
rules.ui_message: It ends with the decision or next step requested

rules.requirement: Project concepts should not present tentative assumptions as finalized commitments.
rules.ui_message: Tentative assumptions are not presented as commitments

rules.requirement: Field-specific character limits trigger form mode.
rules.ui_message: Each form box has its own limit

rules.requirement: Every form-mode field must comply with its own limit.
rules.ui_message: Every form box is within its limit

rules.requirement: Avoid unnecessary duplication across short form fields.
rules.ui_message: The short boxes do not repeat each other

rules.requirement: Concept-note language should prioritize decision usefulness over exhaustive technical detail.
rules.ui_message: It is useful for a decision rather than exhaustive

rules.requirement: Explicit failed applicant eligibility prevents submission-ready status.
rules.ui_message: You meet the call's eligibility criteria

rules.requirement: Explain partner roles when partners are material to delivery.
rules.ui_message: Partners' roles are clear

rules.requirement: No section should consume disproportionate space at the expense of highly weighted relevance/fit criteria.
rules.ui_message: No section crowds out the most heavily weighted ones

rules.requirement: All blocking Concept Note rules must pass before READY status.
rules.ui_message: All blocking Concept Note rules must pass before READY status.
